data.visual_concept: A single industrial-style electricity meter, large and centered in the frame, mounted flush on a plain concrete wall. The meter's dial or digital display is the focal point, occupying roughly the upper third of the composition, with the needle or numerals just visible in soft directional light falling from the upper left. A single vertical conduit runs down from the meter toward the bottom of the frame, acting as a leading line that draws the eye upward to the display. The surrounding wall is bare and slightly cool-toned — grey-white — keeping all visual weight on the meter itself. Lighting is overcast and diffuse with a faint warm highlight on the meter face, suggesting rising consumption measured against an indifferent, impersonal infrastructure.
